name: Form layout
purpose: Composes Input-fields field groups (label · help · boxed field · message) into a whole form: fieldset/legend structure, proximity-grouped field pairs, inline validation per field plus a form-level error summary with focus management, and an action bar on the Mono button ladder. Itinerary row 13 (P1) — the biggest single gap; built Phase-2 wave 1.

props.name: errorSummary
props.$note: Form-level summary (ctkn-020 exact title string), role=alert, links focus the failing field.

props.name: pairRow
props.$note: Two related fields side by side (proximity, aid-004); stacks below 520px.

props.name: help
props.$note: One-sentence hint above the field (copy-041: never hyperlinks).

props.name: optionalMarker
props.$note: '(optional)' ink marker beside the label — required is the default, unmarked (intro line states it).

variants.name: default
variants.use: Single-column form, action bar right-aligned, primary right.

variants.name: narrow
variants.use: Below 520px: pair rows stack; action bar stacks with primary promoted to the top (Tranche-6).

tokens.error: rag/error + rag/error-tint (R-D20); message TEXT stays text/default — colour is never the only channel
tokens.motion: component-type/button-family/press-travel + press-darken (B-D7; injection pending conductor registration)
tokens.$input-error-slot: OPEN (ADR-0010): the anticipated per-theme input-error flex slot is NOT yet declared in tokens — this organism binds the semantic rag/error role and should follow the slot when declared.

behaviour.fallback: The form submits natively (a GET; `novalidate` is authored, so native constraint validation is off as well); no per-field errors, no error summary, no sort-code masking.

$note.validation: Validate on submit; per-field errors + summary together. A field's error lifts as soon as its value re-validates (input event). Focus moves to the summary (tabindex=-1) on failure; summary links focus their field.
$note.masking: Sort code groups digits 00-00-00 as typed (Tranche-6 mask pattern).

behaviour.$fallbackRender: PROVEN by JS-off render #245 (2026-09-03): 4/4 named assertions held, JavaScript disabled at the context, page.goto(file://) — notes/_subreports/assets/2026-09-03-245-L2-populate/jsoff-render.json · jsoff-form-layout-{before,after}.png

accessibility.structure: fieldset + legend name the form region; every input has a real <label for>; help/messages joined via aria-describedby.
accessibility.errors: aria-invalid on failing inputs; inline messages aria-live=polite; the summary is role=alert and receives focus — WCAG 3.3.1 Error Identification, 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions, 2.4.3 Focus Order. (3.3.3 Error Suggestion is met by the 'Enter…, like…' message copy — SC not in the compliance lookup yet, so kept out of relatedSC.)
accessibility.colour: Error text is ink; the rag colour lives in the stroke + roundel only (1.4.1 Use of Colour). Roundel mark knocks to its ground (policy).

tokenValidation.result: PASS — new build, no deprecated tokens: field chrome binds live form/* set, error set = R-D20 rag/error*, buttons = the Mono button/* ladder, radius = control role, motion = component-type/button-family params (values byte-identical to Button's blocks).
tokenValidation.$note: input-error per-theme flex slot (ADR-0010, Dave's buildout ruling) is NOT yet declared in the store — binding rag/error until it lands; receipt-flagged.

provenance.$note: Itinerary row 13 (P1), Phase-2 wave 1 worker A. Anatomy authority = the gated Input-fields snippet (Figma 65570:211753 via that file); organism structure = Tranche-6 (near-canonical, ruling 3). No dedicated Figma node bound yet.

antiPatterns: Red error message text (message stays ink — colour is never the only channel).
Placeholder-as-label (copy-040: placeholders empty except data-entry formats).
Disabling the submit button instead of validating on submit (errors must be announced, not silently prevented).
Local press-physics CSS on the action buttons (ADR-0013: physics arrives via the injected partial).
